title: 第13章 洗劫

content_zh:
大家都存了小心，交换很是顺利，渐渐的，气氛热烈起来，一些正在观望的人也都按捺不住了，开始出手交换。
等到众人都交换的差不多了，方行便站了出来，朗声道：“小弟也有一样东西交换，不过一口价，一百五十颗灵石，少一颗都不换，唉，实际上，一百五十颗灵石，我已经赔了，毕竟这玩意儿，可是我在拜入仙门之前，求我那个老爹花了三万两金子买来的……”
他这一开口，立刻将所有人的目光都吸引了过来。
先前那个年青人，拿出了价值一百块灵石的中阶飞剑，都让人如此震惊，更何况此时又有一个叫价一百五十块的？而且他还说什么只换一百五十块已是亏了，如此异宝，谁又不想赶紧过来瞧一瞧？尤其是那个大耗子精，眼睛都眯成一缝了，飞快靠了过来。
“到底是何法器，能价值三万两金子？快拿出来瞧一瞧？”
方行道：“这位师兄，看你也是个识货的，正要请你鉴定一番，看看这东西是价值三百块灵石，还是可以再加一点……”
说着手掌一摊，露出了一个珑玲奇巧的烟壶，在月光下微微散发出了灵光。
“咦？”
大耗子精打量了一眼，感觉这确实是一个灵器，只是觉得有些不对，似乎还值不得三万两金子，但他听方行说的自信，心下便有些不敢确认，于是凑近了去看。
旁边的人也都是同样的想法，一起凑近了脑袋过来看。
“确实是件法器，不过貌似值不了三万两金子，这位师兄莫非被人骗了？”
“嘿，师兄不会故意叫价，想哄我们出高价吧？”
“也不见得，这位师兄，这法器是不是有什么不凡之处，可否让我等一观？”
众人都低声的讨论，也有人想看一下这法器的施展。
“当然可以，哼，说这法器不值三万两金子的老兄，我都不愿说你，眼光可真露烂的，今天我就冲你这句话，也要让你们见识见识，什么叫作真正的法器！”方行装模作样，手掌摊开，按在了烟壶上空，低声道：“都睁大了眼，这法器妙在细微处，不仔细看可不行……”
听他这么一说，众人顿时忍不住凑得更近了一些。
“天灵灵地灵灵，三万两金子的法器，显灵吧！”
方行见众人距离都差不多了，便低声一喝，一掌打在了烟壶上面。
“嗤……”
忽然之间，烟壶里飞出了一道烟雾。

那道烟雾，呈淡青色，嗅入鼻中之后，只觉香甜侵脑。
靠近了烟壶的几个灵动一重弟子，立刻便脑袋一晃，昏倒在了地上。
那几个灵动二重的也是身子一震，想要挣扎，却只觉浑身无力，慢慢软倒。
而那个耗子精，修为最高，抵抗力也最强，感觉不对劲之后，立刻就要抽身逃开，但他离得烟壶最近，而且方行在释放毒烟之时，直接便朝着他的鼻孔喷了过去，见他又退，也跟着猛然一跳，朝着他追了过去，烟壶始终在他面前一尺处，朝着他面部一阵猛喷。
“你……”
大耗子精小眼圆瞪，指着方行想要大叱，但一阵头昏眼花，身子慢慢软倒了。
不过此时他面上的表情，显然非常的不甘。
他平时为人小心，这次来了之后，也一直在防着那几个看起来像是青云宗老弟子的家伙，只是无论如何也万万没想到，一个刚入仙门的弟子就有如此胆子，敢做出这等事来。
一时不慎，中了陷阱，也只能自认倒楣。
“特么的，差点害老子失败！”
方行狠狠在他身上踹了一脚，还踩着一点肉使劲碾了碾，发现大耗子精毫无反应，这才放下心来，能忍着这份痛苦一点反应没有人的可谓没有，看样子他是真迷昏了。
四叔送给自己的这个迷烟壶是真不赖，不过自己也是冒着险的，方行知道，这迷烟虽然不凡，但对手修为越高，抵抗力便越强，当初四叔自己还有一个比这更大的，只不过在朝着肖剑鸣与座下铁鹰喷出去了之后，对方竟然只是晃了晃，旋及便一剑将他斩成了两半。
由此可见，这迷烟至少对灵动七重以上的真门弟子，是接近完全无效的。
而杜方敢于干这一票，也在之前朝自己测试过，稍稍朝着自己释放了一点迷烟，立刻就昏昏沉沉的睡了一天一夜，凭这一点，就断定用它来干一票是可能的。

content_en:
Everyone was careful, and the exchange went very smoothly. Gradually, the atmosphere became heated, and some people who were watching couldn't hold it back anymore, and started to exchange.
When everyone had almost exchanged, Fang Xing stood up and said loudly: "I also have something to exchange, but the price is one hundred and fifty spirit stones, and I won't exchange for one less. Alas, in fact, I have already lost the one hundred and fifty spirit stones. After all, this thing, before I joined the Immortal Sect, I begged my father to buy it for thirty thousand taels of gold..."
His opening immediately attracted everyone's attention.
The young man who brought out a mid-level flying sword worth one hundred spiritual stones earlier was so shocking. What's more, there is another one asking for one hundred and fifty yuan now? Moreover, he also said that just exchanging one hundred and fifty yuan was already a loss. Who wouldn’t want to come over and take a look at such a rare treasure? Especially the big rat spirit, his eyes narrowed and he came over quickly.
"What kind of magical weapon is it worth thirty thousand taels of gold? Take it out and take a look at it?"
Fang Xingdao: "Senior brother, I see that you are also a good judge of goods. I am about to ask you to appraise it to see if this thing is worth three hundred spiritual stones, or if you can add a little more..."
As he spoke, he spread his palms, revealing a Longling Qiqiao tobacco bottle, which glowed slightly under the moonlight.
"Huh?"
The big rat spirit took a look at it and felt that it was indeed a spiritual weapon, but he felt something was wrong. It didn't seem to be worth thirty thousand taels of gold. However, after hearing Fang Xing's confidence, he felt a little afraid to confirm it, so he got closer and took a closer look.
The people next to him also had the same idea, and they all moved their heads closer to take a look.
"It is indeed a magic weapon, but it doesn't seem to be worth thirty thousand taels of gold. Could this senior brother have been deceived?"
"Hey, senior brother won't intentionally raise the price to coax us into paying a high price, right?"
"Not necessarily. Senior brother, is there anything extraordinary about this magic weapon? Can you let me wait and see?"
Everyone was discussing in low voices, and some wanted to see the magic weapon in action.
"Of course, huh, I don't want to talk about you, brother, who said that this magic weapon is not worth thirty thousand taels of gold. You are really blind. Today I will say this to you, and I want to let you see what a real magic weapon is!" Fang Xing pretended, spread his palms, pressed them on the smoke pot, and whispered: "Everyone opened their eyes wide, this magic weapon is wonderful in the details, you can't do it if you don't look carefully..."
After hearing what he said, everyone couldn't help but get closer.
"The sky is full of spirits, the earth is full of spirits, the magical weapon worth thirty thousand taels of gold, please manifest it!"
When Fang Xing saw that everyone was almost at the same distance, he shouted in a low voice and hit the tobacco pot with his palm.
"Tsk..."
Suddenly, a stream of smoke flew out of the tobacco pot.
The smoke was light blue in color, and after sniffing it into my nose, I felt the sweetness invading my brain.
Several first-level spiritual disciples who approached the tobacco pot immediately shook their heads and fainted on the ground.
Those two-level agile ones were also shaken and tried to struggle, but they felt weak and slowly collapsed.
As for the rat spirit, who had the highest level of cultivation and the strongest resistance, when he felt something was wrong, he immediately wanted to run away, but he was closest to the tobacco pot, and when Fang Xing released the poisonous smoke, he sprayed it directly into his nostrils. When he saw him retreating, he also jumped suddenly and chased after him. The tobacco pot was always one foot in front of him and sprayed fiercely towards his face.
"You..."
The big rat's little eyes widened, and he pointed at Fang Xing and wanted to scream, but he felt dizzy and his body slowly collapsed.
But the expression on his face at this time was obviously very unwilling.
He was usually cautious, and after arriving this time, he had been guarding against those guys who looked like old disciples of the Qingyun Sect. However, he never expected that a disciple who had just entered the Immortal Sect would be so courageous and dare to do such a thing.
Accidental moment, if you fall into the trap, you can only admit your misfortune.
"What the hell, I almost failed!"
Fang Xing kicked him hard, stepped on a bit of flesh and crushed it hard. He found that the big rat had no reaction at all, so he felt relieved. There was no one who could endure the pain and didn't react at all. It looked like he was really in a coma.
The smoke pot that the fourth uncle gave him was really good, but he was taking risks. Fang Xing knew that although the smoke was extraordinary, the higher the opponent's cultivation level, the stronger the resistance. The fourth uncle himself had a bigger one than this, but after spraying it at Xiao Jianming and his subordinate Tie Ying, the opponent just shook it, and cut him in half with a sword.
It can be seen that this smoke is almost completely ineffective against the true disciples who are at least the seventh level of agility.
Du Fang dared to do this job, and he had tested it on himself before. He released a little smoke towards himself, and immediately fell into a drowsy sleep for a day and night. Based on this, he concluded that it was possible to use it to do a job.
